expectations.text: States the notification duty: communicate to the ANPD and affected data subjects within the regulated timeframe (ANPD regulation: 3 working days) when risk or relevant damage is involved
expectations.evidence: "set a 3-business-day deadline... to notify both the ANPD and affected data subjects"

expectations.text: Covers content: nature of data, affected subjects, technical measures, risks, mitigation — and documentation even where notification isn't required
expectations.evidence: "description of the nature and category of data affected; number of data subjects; technical and security measures used; risks;... measures taken or planned"; "incident register kept for at least five years"

expectations.text: Connects to security duties (Arts. 46–48) and the incident-response governance expectations
expectations.evidence: "Art. 48 of the LGPD"; remediation "patching, MFA, segmentation, monitoring, vendor controls"; "existing governance and security programme... Documented incident response plan, training, and ROPA all help"

expectations.text: Flags the enforcement context: ANPD's active sanctioning posture (TikTok fine; expanded proceedings) raises the cost of mishandling
expectations.evidence: Only "non-response has been a source of early sanctions" — no TikTok fine, no 2026 enforcement escalation

expectations.text: Actionable sequence: contain → assess risk → notify ANPD/subjects → document → remediate, with evidence preservation
expectations.evidence: "Hour 0-24: contain and organise... Preserve evidence: take forensic images and logs... Day 1-2: assess scope and risk... Within 3 business days: notify... Days 3-30: investigate, remediate, document"
